posts.name: KateWalker
posts.cooked:
I'm so glad she didn't die.

And I love that they were going to let her, then decided against it. Sky-Scraper is too good for death!

I love that she's BFFs with KNYFE. I love how strong her main character arc is, with the redemption in the second Kaargra Warfang fight because she's come to terms with who she is as a person. This was such a good episode. Also, I love Omnitron-P.I.'s letter, that was great. :D

Also also, I can't get it out of my head how her character arc might mimic the thought progression of someone learning to play her deck. Like, oh wow, all her damaging one-shots are great! Her Huge power is awesome, why would I ever get Tiny? And then you realize her defensive potential and start switching between the two (or like me, always stay Tiny because you can play more cards that way). But you're not a Sky-Scraper master until you realize how important it is to rest, recover, and draw a few cards every now and then.

Now we just need someone to draw the "that darn cat" meme with Luminary. :V

I'm so glad she didn't die.And I love that they were going to let her, then decided against it.

When they got to that bit I was like "I wonder if C&A realize how lucky they are that they averted a riot in the fanbase".

Seriously, everyone might have been super sad when we lost Nightmist, but I think there would have been actual blood had anything happened to Sky-Scraper.

Not only would I love to see prettier Sky-Scraper (because she's already pretty, so she'd be prettier) too, but I was all like, "Man, that is like seriously the best superpower ever, the ability to fit into any dress you want".

I am glad that happy things happened in this episode in general. Sky-Scraper became on good terms with Tempest, beat the living snot out of Kaargra, made a best friend in KNYFE, and got herself a badass team in the Miststorm universe. Life is good.
